lines.text: Launch day, Orbit! Flight Night is go. Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges at mission control, and a rival already on the pad.
Orbit, it is Flight Night! Five judges, two rounds, two dunks apiece. Tonight's rival is fueled up and waiting.
Countdown to Flight Night begins now! Two rounds of two dunks, five judges scoring every landing, and one rival standing between you and the stars.
Back for another Flight Night? Orbit never gets tired of a return mission.
Look who docked again! Refueled, rested, and ready for another night of flight.
Another launch, another night under the stars. The pad is yours again.
Tonight's rival just arrived in Orbit, and nobody gets up here by accident.
Across the court, a rival with a flight plan of their own. Engines are warming.
Cass, tonight's rival: flies on autopilot, lands every time, tomahawk loaded. Zero surprises.
Ty brings maximum thrust, every launch, every night. Watch out for that windmill.
Pilot. Yes, really. Scans the sky, then makes the call. Three-sixty on deck.
Zo is in it for the highlight reel. Phones up, Orbit. Zo wants the replay.
Stack launches the wildest dunk first and asks questions at re-entry. Between the legs, probably.
Cadet on the pad. All eyes up.
Launch window is open. Your dunk, your sky.
Orbit, quiet on deck. Our flyer is up.
Tower, stand by. Here comes the flight.
All systems go. Show us something new.
Systems reset. Take it from the top.
Second attempt. Same flight plan, better landing.
Recalibrating. You have another shot at it.
Engines still warm, cadet. Go again!
Final attempt. This launch window is closing.
Last shot at orbit. Stick the landing.
Third and final. All eyes on the pad.
Ignition!
Engines hot...
Three, two, one!
Here comes liftoff!
Go for launch!
Clean launch, clean landing...
Touchdown confirmed...
Into the flight log...
Solid flight, cadet...
Right on the flight plan...
Safe landing, points on the board...
Ooh, now that had some altitude!
Readings are strong on that one!
Smooth re-entry, and the deck approves!
Look at the hang time on that!
Well, well! Somebody brought extra fuel!
That one cleared the upper deck!
Beautiful flight path, beautiful finish!
Orbit, that is how you fly!
We have altitude! We have altitude!
Oh, stop the countdown! Stop everything!
Gravity just filed a complaint!
Mission control, are you seeing this?!
Whoa! That one left the atmosphere!
Somebody call the observatory!
New star in the sky, folks!
Orbit is shaking! The planet is shaking!
Rewrite the flight manual!
Put that one in the star charts!
Fifty! Perfect score! Mission control is on its feet!
Five judges, five tens. That is a perfect orbit!
Perfect fifty! Paint it on the side of the rocket!
Ten, ten, ten, ten, ten! Flawless flight!
Seen it! That flight plan already flew tonight.
Repeat flight! The judges already logged that one.
Same orbit, same view. The judges want a new route.
Nice landing, but that satellite already launched tonight.
Mission scrubbed! Back to the pad.
Abort, abort! The rim said negative.
We lost the signal on that one.
Rough landing, cadet. Shake it off.
Gravity wins that round.
So close to touchdown. Almost had it.
Off the iron and back into orbit!
Circled the rim like a moon, then out!
So close! The docking clamps would not hold!
That lob slipped out of orbit!
Where is that ball going? Deep space!
Missed the rendezvous. The ball never docked.
Clipped it on the way up!
Contact with the obstacle! Landing gear caught.
Obstacle clearance: negative. So close!
Launch window closed. That one goes down as a miss.
Out of attempts. Mission scrubbed, but the night goes on.
Three tries, no touchdown. Logged as a miss.
Mission control, your scores?
Judges are conferring...
Transmitting scores now...
Awaiting the verdict...
Rival on the pad. Clear the runway.
Next launch belongs to the rival. Eyes up.
Cass on the pad. Autopilot engaged.
Ty is up. Brace for thrust.
Pilot, you are cleared for takeoff.
Zo is up, and the cameras know it.
Stack is up. Something wild is coming.
The rival sticks the landing...
Solid flight from across the court...
Respect to the other crew...
Ooh, the rival found some altitude!
Cass, autopilot, perfect landing...
Ty with the heavy thrust, as advertised...
Pilot calculated every inch of that...
Zo plays to the cameras, and delivers...
Stack went for the wild one, and landed...
Rival misses! Your mission is very much alive.
Scrubbed on the other side! Opening for you.
Off the rim! That is a gift!
Hard landing for the rival. Stay ready.
No touchdown! The rival comes up empty.
Round two, final round! Next stop, the stars.
Final round at Flight Night! Everything you have, all engines.
Stage two separation! We are in the final round, Orbit!
Trailing into the final round. You need big altitude now.
Behind on the board, cadet. Time to burn every drop of fuel.
Big numbers needed, cadet. Go higher than you have ever gone.
You are ahead, cadet. Bring this mission home. Smooth and steady.
Leading into the final round. Keep it clean, close it out.
Mission control, confirm it: we have a new commander of the sky!
Touchdown! Our cadet wins Flight Night, and Orbit will be talking about it for light-years.
The planet rose tonight just to watch you fly. What a champion, cadet!
What a flight! The rival is grounded, and the stars are yours tonight.
The rival takes Flight Night. Tough one, cadet, but you flew with everything.
Mission incomplete, cadet. The hangar is open, and the pad will wait.
Crown goes to the rival tonight. Orbit saw real flight from you, though.
Refuel, regroup, relaunch, cadet. The rival wins this one, not the next.
Down in the splits! Zero gravity, full flexibility!
It's over? Mission control concurs!
Listen to that roar! Louder than liftoff!
Too small! That rim looked tiny from orbit!
Arms up! The whole observation deck rises!
Controller changes hands. Next cadet to the pad!
Crew change! Pass it over, new flight up.
Handing off to player one. Controls are yours!
Player two, you are cleared for launch!
That settles the Dunk Duel! Touchdown for the winner!
Player one takes the Dunk Duel! New commander on deck!
Victory for player two! Bragging rights, now in orbit!
Perfectly tied! Two ships, one orbit, no winner yet.
Level at the finish! Same altitude, same score.
